slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video behind the navbar + headline (absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full object-cover z-0, so it crops to any viewport) inside the h-screen overflow-hidden hero section; native asset is a luxury-real-estate establishing clip. autoPlay muted loop playsInline. A semi-transparent bg-white/10 content overlay sits over it at z-10, so the footage should read cleanly under near-black text and a dark CTA button.

The three property listing photos in the Properties grid (Aether Heights / Azure Sanctuary / Summit Pavilion). Each renders inside an image wrapper that is aspect-[4/3] on mobile and aspect-square on md+, overflow-hidden, with group-hover:scale-105 duration-700 (so the subject must survive a 5% zoom-in crop and a non-square-to-square aspect shift). Order is data-paired with title/price/location/stats in the inline property array. Native assets are exterior architectural renders served through the images.higgs.ai webp proxy.

The large showcase image filling the right 8 columns of the How-it-Works 12-column grid (aspect-video on mobile, aspect-square on md+). Pairs with the 'Exclusive collection' content block on the left 4 columns. Native asset is an interior/lifestyle real-estate render served through the images.higgs.ai webp proxy.

Single global typeface for the entire page — headline, navbar, body, subtext, prices, stat labels, chart titles and chart values. Native family: Lato (Google Font, weights 300/400/500/700/900), wired via Tailwind v4 @theme { --font-lato } and applied as font-lato globally. The logo wordmark ('ZENITH' over 'REALTY') uses font-black (900) leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter, and the hero headline uses font-medium (500) tracking-tight leading-[1.05], so the replacement must carry both a heavy 900 and a clean 500 weight and hold tight negative tracking.

Navbar glyphs from lucide-react: ChevronDown twice (on the 'Properties' and 'Careers' links), Home (leading the 'Post a property' action button), and the Menu/X pair driving the mobile slide-in toggle. Rendered near-black (#141414) at small sizes; themeable via stroke/currentColor.

The four property-stat glyphs from lucide-react reused across all three cards, laid out inline in a flex-wrap row: Square (area m2), Layers (floors), Bed (beds), Bath (baths). Rendered in the muted grey (#A5A5A5) at size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} beside #141414 11px stat labels.

mechanic: A scroll of four stacked full-width sections (h-screen hero with a fullscreen looping background video + 12-col grid navbar/headline, then 3-card property grid, then a 4/8 split how-it-works showcase, then a 3-card analytics row) where the hero headline fades up (y:30, 0.9s) with delayed-fade CTA/subtext, the property and content cards stagger fade-and-slide-up on first scroll into view (viewport once), images zoom group-hover:scale-105, the mobile menu slides in from the right via AnimatePresence, and each analytics card paints a recharts BarChart whose bars are a custom two-rect shape (5%-opacity black body + 2px solid black top cap).
techDelivery: React with Tailwind v4 (@theme { --font-lato } in index.css, font-lato applied globally), motion/react for animation (motion.div + AnimatePresence), lucide-react for icons, and recharts (ResponsiveContainer + BarChart with a custom Bar shape) for the analytics sparkline charts; Google Font Lato loaded as the single typeface.
reskinNotes: Every color is a hardcoded Tailwind arbitrary value inline (bg-[#F8F8F8], text-[#141414], text-[#A5A5A5], bg-white, border-black/10, the New badge bg-black, the chart fill="#141414" + fillOpacity 0.05 / 0.4-tint) rather than CSS variables, so retinting means editing class strings and the recharts shape function across all four sections; there is no distinct accent hue — near-black #141414 doubles as both fg and the only accent (CTA fills, top-cap line). All copy is hardcoded in JSX, including the three properties' titles/prices/locations/stats and the three chart titles/values. The analytics bars are NOT image/SVG asset sockets: each chart is driven by an inline numeric data array ([35,60,45,...] etc.) and rendered by a custom two-rectangle Bar shape, so theming the charts is a code edit, not an asset swap. The hero 'background' is the video itself (bg-[#F8F8F8] is only the page fallback). Layout is font-metric dependent — the stacked logo uses leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter and the headline uses tight negative tracking with fixed leading, so a wider replacement face shifts the navbar/headline geometry. The Tailwind v4 @theme font token (--font-lato) must be re-declared for any substitute family. The 'New' badge uses rounded-xs and buttons use rounded-none (sharp corners), a deliberate radius language to preserve. Placeholder asset hosts: video on d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net, images via the images.higgs.ai webp proxy.
